description: ApplicationBuilderHelpers for building an application with dependency injection.
releaseNotes:
## New Version
* Bump `application_builder_helpers` from `4.1.141` to `4.1.142`. See [changelog](https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/compare/application_builder_helpers/4.1.141...application_builder_helpers/4.1.142)

## What's Changed
* fix(cli): invariant-culture scalar parsing (Fixes #451, root cause: ambient-culture TryParse/ChangeType) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/472
* fix(cli): harden SetHelpWidth boundary + floor help layout at 60 (Fixes #450) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/471
* fix(cli): reject flag-looking valued-option neighbors (Fixes #469) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/475
* fix(cli): friendly help placeholders (Fixes #454) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/473
* refactor(cli): split HelpFormatter into content/layout/model (Fixes #456) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/476
* refactor(cli): extract CommandExecutor lifecycle collaborators (Fixes #455) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/479
* fix(cli): shared global-option identity (Fixes #453) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/477
* refactor(cli): unify option/argument construction path (Fixes #452) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/474
* fix(cli): unknown-shell completion script exits 2 via shared canonicalizer by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/494
* feat(cli): share enum auto-population with positional arguments (Fixes #478) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/495
* fix: fail satisfied-required bare repeat as missing (Fixes #470) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/500
* fix(cli): route CancelKeyPress fallback notes to stdout by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/506
* chore(skills): normalize two frontmatter names to lowercase-hyphen by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/514
* fix(cli): fail trailing-bare valued option with flag neighbor as missing (Fixes #503) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/515
* fix(cli): substitute command path in per-command error footers (Fixes #504) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/516
* cli: remove obsolete GetTypeDisplayName leaf, point ADR to HelpTypeDisplay (Fixes #492) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/517
* fix(cli): report registration-time default in help for instance commands (Fixes #481) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/518
* cli: route help categorization via IsGlobal and command lineage (Fixes #491) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/521
* fix(cli): normalize mixed-type FromAmong candidates before Equals (Fixes #486) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/519
* refactor(cli): dedup help colon-split branches via shared wrap routine (Fixes #490) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/522
* fix(cli): aggregate missing-required and invalid-value errors (Fixes #496) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/520
* fix(cli): unify CLI-bound identity and share cache core (Fixes #488) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/523
* refactor(cli): delegate help option signature to single builder (Fixes #489) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/525
* fix(cli): bare numeric token wins over digit short by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/524
* cli: probe conversions before help-with-values so InvalidValue beats help (Fixes #483) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/526
* fix(cli): append did-you-mean on RequiresSubcommand near-miss (Fixes #498) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/527
* docs: align DuplicateOption docs to last-wins per #497 by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/528
* fix(cli): harden merged-copy bind preference (Fixes #482) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/529
* fix(cli): list --version in help and error footers (Fixes #511) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/532
* refactor(cli): single holding-scope owner for option defaults, delete legacy scan by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/530
* fix(cli): report unknown root flag as UnknownOption on abstract command (Fixes #508) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/534
* fix(cli): mark required options and suppress phantom default (Fixes #507) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/533
* fix(cli): gate reserved help-word =-forms and --no-help as InvalidValue by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/531
* fix(cli): valued --no-<name> remedy omits failing bare form (root cause: unguarded IsFlag suggestion) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/536
* fix(cli): reserve help/version shorts (Fixes #499) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/535
* fix(cli): help beats missing required, footer points at working help by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/537
* fix(cli): require subcommand for abstract root commands by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/538
* fix(cli): abstract root reports InvalidValue for negated valued option by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/540
* fix(cli): abstract root reports InvalidValue for positive =-form flag literal (Fixes #542) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/544
* fix(cli): pin positional arguments leaf-local (Fixes #543) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/546
* fix(cli): suppress did-you-mean self-echo on exact surplus token (Fixes #541) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/545
* chore: comment-jargon cleanup plus approved test-log deletions by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/547
* fix: resolve XML doc warnings (CS1570/CS1574) by @Kiryuumaru in https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/pull/548

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kiryuumaru/ApplicationBuilderHelpers/compare/build.20260917103104.6134f4f...build.20260923094141.73156fb
